use_case_summary: LotusLane is building an in-app onboarding copilot (guided flows) plus a lightweight support assistant. Primary constraints: strict 200-300ms token-to-token latency for streaming UI, reliable tool-calls (calendar, user-profile fetch), and a tight monthly token cap per workspace. Want hosted API to validate UX and latency; if metrics stable, move to dedicated for predictability and lower unit cost.
notes:
Account background: product-led growth, 350 employees, heavy mobile/web hybrid. Focus is onboarding flows that guide new users through feature discovery — conversational UI with step-by-step suggestions and occasional tool calls (verify email, pull user prefs).

Key pain points / ask from call:
- "Latency is the killer; we need stream feel native to the app (aim 200-300ms per token, tail latency <500ms)." — Head of Product.
- Token budget: pilots capped at 2M tokens/month; cost predictability is essential.
- Resilience: automatic fallback to smaller model or cached responses if latency spikes.

POC plan (agreed):
- Phase 1 (hosted API): 3-day stress test (simulated onboarding funnel, concurrent sessions 200-500), measure median/tail latency, streaming quality, tool-calling reliability. Redwood to provide warmup guidance and batching configs.
- Phase 2 (pricing + Dedicated quote): if SLOs met, propose 3-month dedicated pilot with reserved capacity and burst buffer.

Security & compliance notes:
- Requires SSO/SAML, audit logs shipped to their SIEM, KMS integration for key material. Data residency: US-only for pilot.
- Sent security FAQ 2025-12-08 (drive/lotuslane/security-faq-response.pdf).

Commercials:
- Initially cost-sensitive but willing to convert if dedicated reduces per-token cost and solves latency jitter. Budget owner: VP Ops (review in procurement cycle).
